patch_description: Replace local 2-exchange search with a model-based search over complete valid networks. Each network is constructed as two edge-disjoint bipartite perfect matchings, which guarantees exactly two incoming and two outgoing links with no self-loops. An adaptive cross-entropy model learns edge preferences from high-quality, structurally diverse LP-scored networks, while randomized matching, donor networks, and occasional uniform sampling preserve exploration. This searches by recombining learned edge patterns rather than repeatedly screening local moves.
